provenance.paper_title: Towards Verifiable Multimodal Deep Research: A Multi-Agent Harness for Interleaved Report Generation

representation_paths.memory_component: source-aligned images in a Visual Working Memory

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Visual Working Memory entries (source-aligned images) plus claim-grounded evidence records. declarative multimodal tool use over Visual Working Memory during report composition.
During operation, Ptah applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to source-aligned images in a Visual Working Memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF pp. 3–4): The visual working memory is updated as observations arrive (M_t), so inference changes persistent operative state under fixed logic. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
